## Interfaces

### `ldp.security.security`

Client-facing capability interface: discover effective scopes, request escalation (brokered user prompt), and submit tokens received from the broker out-of-band (e.g. from a portal).

*global (registry-advertised)*

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `capabilities` | 1 | `capabilities` | — |
| 2 | `request` | 1 | — | `scope: enum<scope>`, `reason: string` |
| 3 | `submit_token` | 1 | — | `token: array<uint32>` |

* `request.reason` — Human-readable justification shown in the prompt.
* `submit_token.token` — Exactly 8 elements.

#### Events

| Opcode | Name | Since | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `capabilities` | 1 | `scopes: bitset<scopes>` |
| 2 | `grant` | 1 | `scope: enum<scope>`, `token: array<uint32>`, `expires: ts` |
| 3 | `deny` | 1 | `scope: enum<scope>`, `reason: enum<denied_reason>` |
| 4 | `revoked` | 1 | `scope: enum<scope>` |

* `grant.token` — 8-element 256-bit token.

### `ldp.security.audit`

The audit stream reader (scope-gated: `audit_read`). Records are hash-chained; `verify` checks the chain integrity over the retained window.

*global (registry-advertised)*

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `subscribe` | 1 | — | `filter: bitset<audit_filter>` |
| 2 | `verify` | 1 | `chain` | — |

#### Events

| Opcode | Name | Since | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `record` | 1 | `ts: ts`, `client: uint32`, `app_id: string`, `scope: enum<scope>`, `action: enum<audit_action>`, `detail: string` |
| 2 | `chain` | 1 | `ok: bool`, `records: uint64` |

* `record.detail` — Structured detail (JSON object as string).
* `chain.records` — Number of records covered by the verified window.
